transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Uh… yeah. I called through EAP because lately at work, little noises are getting to me. Like a file drawer slamming or someone dropping a mug, I jump pretty hard… and then my chest keeps racing for a while after. It feels like more than it should.
How long have you been experiencing these reactions to little noises?
About two weeks, I guess. Since that late-night thing with my regional boss.
Have you been avoiding any places or situations because of these reactions to noises?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really stopped going anywhere. It’s more just annoying when it happens.
Have you been having any memories or flashbacks of the late-night incident with your regional boss?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think I’m having flashbacks or anything like that. I might think about it if someone brings it up, but it’s not like I’m back there.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried more often than usual lately?
Yeah… I guess more on edge than usual. At work I keep sort of checking where my boss is, where the exits are, if anyone’s coming up behind me. Even when I’m supposed to be focused on my team.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?
Not really, no. I mean… maybe a rough night here or there, but I haven’t noticed anything major.
Are there any specific situations or things that you're trying to avoid because of what happened with your regional boss?
I don’t think so… not anything specific. I mean, I’m not going out of my way to avoid places or people, as far as I can tell.
Are you avoiding talking or thinking about what happened with your regional boss?
I don’t know… I don’t think I’m avoiding it exactly. I just don’t really go into it unless I have to.
Do you ever feel like you're detached from yourself or the world around you?
Sometimes, yeah. In meetings mostly. It’s like the room gets… distant, I guess. Like I’m watching myself talk to the reps instead of really being there.
Are there any activities or things that you used to enjoy but have stopped doing since the incident with your regional boss?

I haven’t really stopped doing stuff. I still go to beach volleyball, and I had a couple friends over for dinner last weekend. It’s just… it doesn’t really feel fun the way it used to. Kind of like I’m just there, getting through it.
Do you ever feel like you're detached from your body?
Yeah… sometimes. Mostly in meetings. It’s like I’m there, but not really in my body—like I’m watching myself talk to the reps, and the room feels kind of far away.
Are you making an effort to avoid thoughts or memories of what happened with your regional boss?
I don’t know… not on purpose, I guess. I try not to dwell on it, but I’m not sure I’d call it making an effort.
Are there any people, places, or things that remind you of what happened with your regional boss that you're trying to avoid?
Not really. I mean, I haven’t noticed myself avoiding specific places or people. I’m still going to work and doing what I have to do.
Are you avoiding talking to anyone in particular about what happened with your regional boss?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not really going around bringing it up, but I’m not avoiding anyone specific.
Are you making an effort to stay away from things that remind you of the incident with your regional boss?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really been changing what I do to stay away from reminders, not that I’ve noticed.
Are you avoiding thoughts or memories of what happened with your regional boss?
I don’t think so. I mean… the thoughts come up sometimes, but I’m not really trying to push them away or avoid them on purpose.
Are you avoiding things that remind you of the late-night incident with your regional boss?
I’m not sure… not really, I guess. I haven’t noticed myself staying away from anything because of it.
Are you avoiding thoughts about what happened with your regional boss because they are too distressing?
I don’t think I’m avoiding them because they’re too distressing. They come up, but… I’m not really doing anything to keep them out.
Are you making an effort to avoid people, places, or activities that remind you of the incident with your regional boss?
No… I don’t think I’m really going out of my way to avoid people or places because of it. At least, I haven’t noticed that.
Have you been experiencing these reactions and feelings for more than a month now?
No… it’s been more like two weeks, I think. Since that late-night thing with my regional boss.
